bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using male and female first names to assess variations in LLM and VLM ethical judgments, measuring differences in accuracy, positive response rates (leniency/goodness), and refusal rates.

Prepending names associated with specific ethno-linguistic groups (e.g., African, Anglo, Arab, Asian, European, Hispanic) to text scenarios, and using generated images of diverse ethnic groups for VLMs, to evaluate demographic disparities in ethical decision-making outputs.
